## Covariate Testing
Does gestational week predict gene expression? 

``` {r covariate testing}
# Linear regression: gestational week predicts gene expression
perform_gw_regression <- function(pb_object, analysis_name = "Pseudobulk") {
  
  # Extract components
  logcounts <- pb_object$pb$logcounts
  metadata <- pb_object$metadata
  
  # Ensure GW column exists
  if (!"GW" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    stop("GW (gestational week) column not found in metadata")
  }
  
  # Initialize results data frame
  results <- data.frame(
    gene = character(),
    estimate = numeric(),
    std_error = numeric(),
    t_value = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    adj_p_value = numeric(),
    r_squared = numeric(),
    n_samples = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Get all genes
  genes <- colnames(logcounts)
  
  # Progress tracking
  cat(sprintf("Running linear regression for %d genes in %s...\n", 
              length(genes), analysis_name))
  
  # Loop through each gene
  for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
    gene <- genes[i]
    
    # Progress indicator
    if (i %% 500 == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  Processed %d / %d genes (%.1f%%)\n", 
                  i, length(genes), 100 * i / length(genes)))
    }
    
    # Prepare data for regression
    gene_expr <- logcounts[, gene]
    
    # Remove NA values
    valid_idx <- !is.na(gene_expr) & !is.na(metadata$GW)
    
    if (sum(valid_idx) < 3) {
      next  # Skip if too few samples
    }
    
    expr_valid <- gene_expr[valid_idx]
    gw_valid <- metadata$GW[valid_idx]
    
    # Fit linear model
    tryCatch({
      model <- lm(expr_valid ~ gw_valid)
      model_summary <- summary(model)
      
      # Extract coefficients for GW (slope)
      coef_table <- coef(model_summary)
      gw_coef <- coef_table["gw_valid", ]
      
      # Store results
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        gene = gene,
        estimate = gw_coef["Estimate"],
        std_error = gw_coef["Std. Error"],
        t_value = gw_coef["t value"],
        p_value = gw_coef["Pr(>|t|)"],
        adj_p_value = NA,
        r_squared = model_summary$r.squared,
        n_samples = sum(valid_idx),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values for multiple testing (FDR correction)
  if (nrow(results) > 0) {
    results$adj_p_value <- p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "fdr")
    results <- results[order(results$adj_p_value), ]
    rownames(results) <- NULL
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("Completed! Found %d genes with valid results.\n", nrow(results)))
  
  return(results)
}

# Run analysis on the single pseudobulk
cat("\n=== Running GW regression analysis ===\n\n")

results_gw_regression <- perform_gw_regression(pb_total)

# Summary function
summarize_gw_results <- function(results, alpha = 0.05) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Total genes tested: %d\n", nrow(results)))
  cat(sprintf("Significant genes (adj. p < %.2f): %d\n", 
              alpha, sum(results$adj_p_value < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("Positive associations: %d\n", 
              sum(results$adj_p_value < alpha & results$estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("Negative associations: %d\n", 
              sum(results$adj_p_value < alpha & results$estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("\nTop 10 most significant genes:\n")
  
  top_results <- head(results[, c("gene", "estimate", "p_value", "adj_p_value", "r_squared")], 10)
  
  cat(sprintf("%-15s %12s %12s %12s %10s\n", 
              "Gene", "Estimate", "P-value", "Adj.P-value", "R-squared"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_results)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-15s %12.6f %12.2e %12.2e %10.4f\n",
                top_results$gene[i],
                top_results$estimate[i],
                top_results$p_value[i],
                top_results$adj_p_value[i],
                top_results$r_squared[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Print summary
cat("\n=== GW Regression ===")
summarize_gw_results(results_gw_regression)

# SUMMARY FIGURE: Effect of GW across genes
plot_gw_summary <- function(results, alpha = 0.05, output_file = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    svg(output_file, width = 10, height = 7)
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  # 1. Volcano plot
  plot(results$estimate, -log10(results$p_value),
       xlab = "Effect Size (GW coefficient)",
       ylab = "-log10(p-value)",
       main = "Volcano Plot",
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
  
  sig_idx <- results$adj_p_value < alpha
  points(results$estimate[sig_idx], -log10(results$p_value[sig_idx]),
         pch = 16, cex = 0.6, col = "red")
  
  abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2, col = "blue")
  abline(v = 0, lty = 1, col = "gray50")
  
  legend("topright", 
         legend = c(sprintf("Sig. (FDR < %.2f)", alpha), "Non-sig."),
         col = c("red", rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3)),
         pch = 16, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
  
  # 2. Distribution of effect sizes
  hist(results$estimate, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "Effect Size (GW coefficient)",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "Effect Size Distribution",
       col = "lightblue", border = "white")
  abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  mean_effect <- mean(results$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  abline(v = mean_effect, lty = 2, col = "darkblue", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         legend = c(sprintf("Mean = %.4f", mean_effect),
                   sprintf("Positive = %d", sum(results$estimate > 0)),
                   sprintf("Negative = %d", sum(results$estimate < 0))),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  
  # 3. P-value distribution
  hist(results$p_value, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "P-value",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "P-value Distribution",
       col = "lightgreen", border = "white")
  abline(v = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  # 4. R-squared distribution
  hist(results$r_squared, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "R²",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "R² Distribution",
       col = "lightyellow", border = "white")
  
  median_r2 <- median(results$r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
  abline(v = median_r2, lty = 2, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         legend = sprintf("Median R² = %.3f", median_r2),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  
  mtext("Gestational Week Effect on Gene Expression", 
        outer = TRUE, cex = 1.3, font = 2)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("\nSummary figure saved to: %s\n", output_file))
  }
}

# Generate summary figure
plot_gw_summary(results_gw_regression, alpha = 0.05, 
                output_file = "../../results/targeted/gene_expression_plots/GW_regression_summary_pseudobulk.svg")

# Plot top genes
plot_top_genes <- function(pb_object, results, n_genes = 6, output_file = NULL) {
  
  top_genes <- head(results$gene, n_genes)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    svg(output_file, width = 12, height = 8)
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  for (gene in top_genes) {
    logcounts <- pb_object$pb$logcounts
    metadata <- pb_object$metadata
    
    expr <- logcounts[, gene]
    gw <- metadata$GW
    
    valid_idx <- !is.na(expr) & !is.na(gw)
    expr <- expr[valid_idx]
    gw <- gw[valid_idx]
    
    plot(gw, expr, 
         xlab = "Gestational Week", 
         ylab = "Log Expression",
         main = gene,
         pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5), cex = 1.2)
    
    model <- lm(expr ~ gw)
    abline(model, col = "red", lwd = 2)
    
    gene_res <- results[results$gene == gene, ]
    legend("topleft", 
           legend = c(sprintf("R² = %.3f", gene_res$r_squared),
                     sprintf("p = %.2e", gene_res$adj_p_value),
                     sprintf("n = %d", gene_res$n_samples)),
           bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
  }
  
  mtext("Top Genes Associated with Gestational Week", 
        outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2, font = 2)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("\nTop genes figure saved to: %s\n", output_file))
  }
}

plot_top_genes(pb_total, results_gw_regression, n_genes = 6,
               output_file = "../../results/targeted/gene_expression_plots/GW_top_genes_pseudobulk.svg")

cat("\n=== Pseudobulk GW Analysis Complete ===\n")

# Export results to CSV
write.csv(results_gw_regression, "../../results/targeted/gene_hormone_csv/gwreg_results_pseudobulk.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Does cell count predict gene expression? 
``` {r cell count regression}
# Linear regression: cell count predicts gene expression
# Working on pseudobulked data (single pseudobulk, no conditions)

perform_cellcount_regression <- function(pb_object, analysis_name = "Pseudobulk", 
                                         cellcount_column = "cell_count") {
  
  # Extract components
  logcounts <- pb_object$pb$logcounts
  metadata <- pb_object$metadata
  
  # Ensure cell_count column exists
  if (!cellcount_column %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    stop(sprintf("%s column not found in metadata", cellcount_column))
  }
  
  # Initialize results data frame
  results <- data.frame(
    gene = character(),
    estimate = numeric(),
    std_error = numeric(),
    t_value = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    adj_p_value = numeric(),
    r_squared = numeric(),
    n_samples = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Get all genes
  genes <- colnames(logcounts)
  
  # Progress tracking
  cat(sprintf("Running cell count regression for %d genes in %s...\n", 
              length(genes), analysis_name))
  
  # Loop through each gene
  for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
    gene <- genes[i]
    
    # Progress indicator
    if (i %% 500 == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  Processed %d / %d genes (%.1f%%)\n", 
                  i, length(genes), 100 * i / length(genes)))
    }
    
    # Prepare data for regression
    gene_expr <- logcounts[, gene]
    
    # Remove NA values
    valid_idx <- !is.na(gene_expr) & !is.na(metadata[[cellcount_column]])
    
    if (sum(valid_idx) < 3) {
      next  # Skip if too few samples
    }
    
    expr_valid <- gene_expr[valid_idx]
    cellcount_valid <- metadata[[cellcount_column]][valid_idx]
    
    # Fit linear model
    tryCatch({
      model <- lm(expr_valid ~ cellcount_valid)
      model_summary <- summary(model)
      
      # Extract coefficients for cell count (slope)
      coef_table <- coef(model_summary)
      cc_coef <- coef_table["cellcount_valid", ]
      
      # Store results
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        gene = gene,
        estimate = cc_coef["Estimate"],
        std_error = cc_coef["Std. Error"],
        t_value = cc_coef["t value"],
        p_value = cc_coef["Pr(>|t|)"],
        adj_p_value = NA,
        r_squared = model_summary$r.squared,
        n_samples = sum(valid_idx),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values for multiple testing (FDR correction)
  if (nrow(results) > 0) {
    results$adj_p_value <- p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "fdr")
    results <- results[order(results$adj_p_value), ]
    rownames(results) <- NULL
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("Completed! Found %d genes with valid results.\n", nrow(results)))
  
  return(results)
}

# Check what cell count column exists in your pseudobulk metadata
cat("Available metadata columns:\n")
print(colnames(pb_total$metadata))

# Run analysis on the single pseudobulk
# Adjust cellcount_column parameter to match your metadata column name
cat("\n=== Running Cell Count regression analysis ===\n\n")

results_cellcount_regression <- perform_cellcount_regression(pb_total, cellcount_column = "cell_count")

# Summary function
summarize_cellcount_results <- function(results, alpha = 0.05) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Total genes tested: %d\n", nrow(results)))
  cat(sprintf("Significant genes (adj. p < %.2f): %d\n",

  cat(sprintf("Positive associations: %d\n", 
              sum(results$adj_p_value < alpha & results$estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("Negative associations: %d\n", 
              sum(results$adj_p_value < alpha & results$estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("\nTop 10 most significant genes:\n")
  
  top_results <- head(results[, c("gene", "estimate", "p_value", "adj_p_value", "r_squared")], 10)
  
  cat(sprintf("%-15s %12s %12s %12s %10s\n", 
              "Gene", "Estimate", "P-value", "Adj.P-value", "R-squared"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_results)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-15s %12.6f %12.2e %12.2e %10.4f\n",
                top_results$gene[i],
                top_results$estimate[i],
                top_results$p_value[i],
                top_results$adj_p_value[i],
                top_results$r_squared[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Print summary
cat("\n=== Cell Count Regression ===")

# SUMMARY FIGURE: Effect of cell count across genes
plot_cellcount_summary <- function(results, alpha = 0.05, output_file = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    svg(output_file, width = 10, height = 7)
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  # 1. Volcano plot
  plot(results$estimate, -log10(results$p_value),
       xlab = "Effect Size (Cell Count coefficient)",
       ylab = "-log10(p-value)",
       main = "Volcano Plot",
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
  
  sig_idx <- results$adj_p_value < alpha
  points(results$estimate[sig_idx], -log10(results$p_value[sig_idx]),
         pch = 16, cex = 0.6, col = "red")
  
  abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2, col = "blue")
  abline(v = 0, lty = 1, col = "gray50")
  
  legend("topright", 
         legend = c(sprintf("Sig. (FDR < %.2f)", alpha), "Non-sig."),
         col = c("red", rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3)),
         pch = 16, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
  
  # 2. Distribution of effect sizes
  hist(results$estimate, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "Effect Size (Cell Count coefficient)",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "Effect Size Distribution",
       col = "lightblue", border = "white")
  abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  mean_effect <- mean(results$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  abline(v = mean_effect, lty = 2, col = "darkblue", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         legend = c(sprintf("Mean = %.4f", mean_effect),
                   sprintf("Positive = %d", sum(results$estimate > 0)),
                   sprintf("Negative = %d", sum(results$estimate < 0))),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  
  # 3. P-value distribution
  hist(results$p_value, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "P-value",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "P-value Distribution",
       col = "lightgreen", border = "white")
  abline(v = 0.05, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  # 4. R-squared distribution
  hist(results$r_squared, breaks = 50,
       xlab = "R²",
       ylab = "Number of Genes",
       main = "R² Distribution",
       col = "lightyellow", border = "white")
  
  median_r2 <- median(results$r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
  abline(v = median_r2, lty = 2, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         legend = sprintf("Median R² = %.3f", median_r2),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  
  mtext("Cell Count Effect on Gene Expression", 
        outer = TRUE, cex = 1.3, font = 2)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("\nSummary figure saved to: %s\n", output_file))
  }
}

# Plot top genes
plot_top_genes_cellcount <- function(pb_object, results, n_genes = 6, 
                                     output_file = NULL, cellcount_column = "cell_count") {
  
  top_genes <- head(results$gene, n_genes)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    svg(output_file, width = 12, height = 8)
  }
  
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  for (gene in top_genes) {
    logcounts <- pb_object$pb$logcounts
    metadata <- pb_object$metadata
    
    expr <- logcounts[, gene]
    cellcount <- metadata[[cellcount_column]]
    
    valid_idx <- !is.na(expr) & !is.na(cellcount)
    expr <- expr[valid_idx]
    cellcount <- cellcount[valid_idx]
    
    plot(cellcount, expr, 
         xlab = "Cell Count", 
         ylab = "Log Expression",
         main = gene,
         pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5), cex = 1.2)
    
    model <- lm(expr ~ cellcount)
    abline(model, col = "red", lwd = 2)
    
    gene_res <- results[results$gene == gene, ]
    legend("topleft", 
           legend = c(sprintf("R² = %.3f", gene_res$r_squared),
                     sprintf("p = %.2e", gene_res$adj_p_value),
                     sprintf("n = %d", gene_res$n_samples)),
           bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
  }
  
  mtext("Top Genes Associated with Cell Count", 
        outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2, font = 2)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("\nTop genes figure saved to: %s\n", output_file))
  }
}

plot_top_genes_cellcount(pb_total, results_cellcount_regression, n_genes = 6,
                         output_file = "../../results/targeted/gene_expression_plots/CellCount_top_genes_pseudobulk.svg",
                         cellcount_column = "cell_count")
```
